full_judgment: 5. In view of the settle principle we are of the view that the entire property of the partition suit will be the value, for the purpose of pecuniary jurisdiction of the court. As we already mention that the entire value of the subject matter is Taka 80,00,000, as mention in the plaint and in the decree. So the instant First Appeal has rightly been filed before this Court. Accordingly the application for returning the memorandum appeal is hereby rejected.
